text: TI Analyst at CNCFlora/JBRJ. PhD and Msc in Botany. Specialist in Mimosa (Leguminosae, Caesalpinioideae). I am interested in plant systematics, evolution, and conservation. I also interested in data science, biodiversity informatics and data management.

TypeTaxonScript
text:
TypeTaxonScript is a framework for managing taxonomic data collaboratively. It allows users to create, edit, and share taxonomic information in a structured format.
https://doi.org/10.1093/biomethods/bpae017
